original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 1 system Manufacturer exactly identifies the approved system vendor, is not a placeholder, and remains unchanged after reboot.
original_method: Collect full Type 1 and exact Manufacturer on the mapped chassis/system, compare with the platform identity source using approved whitespace/case rules, run the approved reboot and repeat while checking surrounding Type 1 consistency.
manual_activity: A user approves the exact vendor identity and reboot plan. Collection and exact persistence checking are automatable.
safety_requirements: Archive full Type 1 and errors before extracting Manufacturer.
Do not accept blank, Default string, OEM placeholder or a motherboard vendor when the field is intended for system manufacturer.
Stop on wrong-asset mapping, identity drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw Type 1/tool/system identity, compare exact Manufacturer and relevant corroborating fields before/after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, infer vendor from hardware logos or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected system-level vendor, aliases and asset mapping.
Resolve ownership/branding discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 1 is appropriate, but grep-only output and stderr suppression reduce evidence and the SSH options are not approved defaults.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved transport; archive dmidecode --version and full sudo dmidecode -t 1 output, then extract exact Manufacturer before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 1 script, Manufacturer scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind Manufacturer to product/serial/UUID and asset identity, reject placeholders, retain raw Type 1 and compare the same system record across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved platform identity/branding recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds system-level identity correlation and placeholder handling.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected vendor, asset mapping and normalization.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: ODM, OEM and customer-branded names may differ; only an approved recipe resolves correctness.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve an OEM/customer brand string. The report must record that identity rule rather than overwrite the master field meaning.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected Manufacturer/aliases, asset identity and tool version
Raw pre-reboot Type 1 plus exact Manufacturer

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently define the Type 1 Manufacturer check.
